 if fields[:7]!=old or fields[2]!=fields[8] or fields[1]!='portable' or fields[7]!='gap':raise ValueError('Unadapted original record source/profile drift')
 cases.append({'id':'sci-execution-'+identity,'sci_id':identity,'obligation_id':'local::tests/reference/sci/evaluator-dispositions.tsv::'+identity,'body_sha256':sci.digest(line),'original_row_sha256':sci.digest(oldline),'source_sha256':sci.digest(old[2]),'original_source_sha256':sci.digest(old[2]),'source':old[2],'original_fields':old,'expected':sci.expected(old),'isolated':True,'reference_isolated':True,'setup':'Unchanged complete portable declaration/method/constructor/recur source, lexical observe, captured streaming stdout and original empty stderr; no source-name alias, host/library/reader fixture or reduced witness.'})
(root/'sources.json').write_text(json.dumps(cases,indent=2)+'\n');before=historical.snapshot();bindings=current.reference_execution_binding();evidence={r['id']:{} for r in cases}

 for identity,layer in layers.items():evidence[identity][kind]=layer

if before!=historical.snapshot() or bindings!=current.reference_execution_binding():raise ValueError('Read-only record inspection input/compiler/executable drift')

(root/'evidence.json').write_text(json.dumps(receipt,indent=2)+'\n')
